Supreme Court Urges Govt on Three-Language Policy Implementation

The Supreme Court has urged the Union government to implement the three-language policy, suggesting a start date of January 1, 2027. The court specifically recommended making the policy mandatory for Class 6 students from that date. This directive aims to provide the government with adequate time for implementation.
